# Overview

Analysis code for Ma et al., *Heterogeneity of Treatment Effects in Psychological
Interventions for Suicidality: A Meta-Epidemiological Study of Location and Scale
Moderators* (submitted to *Journal of Affective Disorders*). Preregistration: OSF
[osf.io/xxx].

**Input.** `master.xlsx`: the Metapsy *Suicide Prevention: Psychological
Interventions vs. Control* database (van Ballegooijen & Harrer, 2025,
<https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.8364508>), placed in the same folder as this file.

**Run.** Knit this file (or run all chunks in order). Intermediate datasets,
`.rda` result objects, CSV tables and the main-text figures (`figures_main/`) are
written to the working directory.

**Structure.**

| Section | Content | Manuscript |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Data preparation, RoB scoring, moderator coding | Methods, Table 1 |
| 2 | Analytic datasets and effect sizes | Methods |
| 3 | Publication bias (Egger's test, limit estimate, income-level check) | Results, Fig. S4, S14 |
| 4 | Overall heterogeneity and univariate location-scale models | Tables S1, S5 |
| 5 | Multi-model selection and model averaging | Tables S8–S21 |
| 6 | Sensitivity analyses (RoB, influential cases, outliers) | Tables S2–S4, S6–S7, S9–S14 |
| 7 | Supplementary figures and tables | Supplement |
| 8 | Main-text Figures 2 and 3 | Figures 2–3 |

**Key analytic decisions.**

1. **Risk of bias.** RoB 2 domains D1–D5 (D4 is rated per outcome). The RoB score
   is the number of domains rated low risk (0–5; higher = lower risk). It is
   included as a covariate in every univariate model and competes as a regular
   candidate in multi-model selection.
2. **Scale component.** Modelled for suicidal ideation only. For suicide attempts
   the unconditional heterogeneity was too low and imprecise to support a scale
   model, so scale is intercept-only (deviation from the preregistration). These
   models are fitted as standard random-effects meta-regressions, which are the
   same models but avoid starting-value failures of the location-scale fitting
   routine (e.g., a factor level with a single comparison, or tau^2 = 0).
3. **Univariate models.** Each moderator plus RoB score, fitted on that
   moderator's own complete cases (REML, Knapp-Hartung). Factor levels with
   fewer than 4 comparisons are not estimated. Likelihood ratio tests (ML) compare
   against a RoB-only model; moderators significant in a Wald test or the LRT are
   checked with permutation tests (1,000 permutations).
4. **Multi-model selection.** 11 candidates (all moderators including RoB score;
   family involvement is examined in univariate models only because it overlaps
   with delivery format and age group). Up to 4 moderators per model, entered in
   both location and scale. All models are fitted on one fixed complete-case
   sample per outcome so AICc values are comparable. Moderator pairs with
   association ≥ .60 (Cramér's V, |r|, or correlation ratio) never enter the
   same model. Results use full model averaging with Akaike weights.
5. **Sensitivity analyses.** (A) univariate models without RoB adjustment;
   (B) multi-model selection with RoB forced into every model; (C) influential
   comparisons removed (`metafor::influence()` default rule on the
   moderator-free model); (D) outliers removed (|studentized residual| > 3).
   C and D refit both the univariate and multi-model stages.
6. **Publication bias.** Egger's regression test. The bias-adjusted estimate is
   the intercept of the Egger regression extrapolated to SE = 0. For ideation, the
   tests are repeated by country income level.

# 1. Data preparation

```{r packages, cache = FALSE}
library(metafor)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)
library(tibble)
library(readxl)
library(writexl)
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)
library(patchwork)
library(viridis)
library(RColorBrewer)

DATA_FILE <- "master.xlsx"
```

```{r data-preparation, cache.extra = tools::md5sum(DATA_FILE)}
master_raw <- read_excel(DATA_FILE, na = c("", " ", "-", "NA", "NR", "na", "nr"))
master <- distinct(master_raw)
cat("Duplicate rows removed:", nrow(master_raw) - nrow(master), "\n")


# ── Risk of bias ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# D1-D3 and D5 are shared across outcomes; D4 (outcome measurement) is rated
# per outcome (rob_4 = ideation, rob_4_at = attempts). Self-reported outcomes
# are rated low risk (Cuijpers et al., 2010; Kuper et al., 2025).

rob_domains_common <- c("rob_1", "rob_2", "rob_3", "rob_5")

clean_rob <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- gsub(intToUtf8(160), " ", x, fixed = TRUE)   # non-breaking spaces
  x <- tolower(trimws(x))
  x[x %in% c("", "-", "na", "nr")] <- NA_character_
  case_when(
    x == "high"                                    ~ "high",
    x %in% c("some concerns", "some")              ~ "some concerns",
    x %in% c("low", "low (self report)",
             "self report", "self-report")         ~ "low",
    TRUE                                           ~ NA_character_
  )
}

# rob_total: overall rating (worst domain), used for the RoB summary figure
# rob_dich:  high vs. low/some concerns (retained for reference)
# rob_score: number of domains rated low (0-5), the covariate used in all models
score_rob <- function(df, domain4) {
  doms <- c(rob_domains_common, domain4)
  df %>%
    transmute(
      .n_na = rowSums(is.na(across(all_of(doms)))),
      rob_total = case_when(
        if_any(all_of(doms), ~ !is.na(.) & . == "high")          ~ "high",
        if_any(all_of(doms), ~ !is.na(.) & . == "some concerns") ~ "some concerns",
        .n_na == 0                                               ~ "low",
        TRUE                                                     ~ NA_character_
      ),
      rob_dich = case_when(
        rob_total == "high"                      ~ "high",
        rob_total %in% c("some concerns", "low") ~ "low_some",
        TRUE                                     ~ NA_character_
      ),
      rob_score = rowSums(across(all_of(doms), ~ . == "low"), na.rm = TRUE)
    ) %>%
    select(-.n_na)
}

master <- master %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(c(rob_domains_common, "rob_4", "rob_4_at")), clean_rob),
         # use the ideation D4 rating where no attempt-specific rating exists
         rob_4_at_use = coalesce(rob_4_at, rob_4))

# Bound by row position (id is not unique). "rob_total_at2" avoids a clash with
# an existing rob_total_at column in master.xlsx.
master <- master %>%
  bind_cols(
    score_rob(master, "rob_4") %>%
      rename(rob_total_si = rob_total, rob_dich_si = rob_dich, rob_score_si = rob_score),
    score_rob(master, "rob_4_at_use") %>%
      rename(rob_total_at2 = rob_total, rob_dich_at = rob_dich, rob_score_at = rob_score)
  )


# ── Moderators ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

master <- master %>%
  mutate(
    # Sample size for ideation (attempts use totaln_arm1/2; see Section 2)
    n_arm1       = as.numeric(n_arm1),
    n_arm2       = as.numeric(n_arm2),
    total_sample = n_arm1 + n_arm2,

    # Delivery format: one modality alone vs. individual + group vs.
    # individual + family. Other combinations are set to missing.
    combi = factor(
      case_when(
        format %in% c("ind", "grp", "group", "fam") ~ "single",
        format == "ind and grp"                     ~ "ind_group",
        format == "ind and fam"                     ~ "ind_family",
        TRUE                                        ~ NA_character_
      ),
      levels = c("single", "ind_group", "ind_family")
    ),
    family_involvement = if_else(format %in% c("fam", "ind and fam"), "yes", "no"),

    # Control condition: five original levels, not collapsed
    control = if_else(
      condition_arm2_new %in% c("wl", "cau", "ecau", "other ctr", "supp"),
      condition_arm2_new, NA_character_
    ),

    age_dich = case_when(
      age_group %in% c("adult", "old", "olderold") ~ "adult",
      age_group %in% c("adol", "child", "yadul")   ~ "young",
      TRUE                                         ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

# Non-active control conditions only
master <- master %>%
  filter(condition_arm2_new %in% c("wl", "cau", "ecau", "other ctr", "supp"))

# One identifier per comparison (study x arms x format)
create_base_id <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(across(c(study, condition_arm1_new, condition_arm2_new,
                    multi_arm1, multi_arm2, format),
                  ~ ifelse(is.na(.), "NA", .))) %>%
    mutate(base_id = paste(study, condition_arm1_new, condition_arm2_new,
                           multi_arm1, multi_arm2, format, sep = "_"))
}

common_vars <- c(
  "id", "study", "condition_arm1_new", "format",
  "control", "combi", "family_involvement", "direct",
  "duration_arm1_n", "total_sample", "rob_dich", "rob_score", "time_weeks", "lmic",
  "disorder_suic", "age_dich", "percent_women", "outcome_type"
)

# Coding checks
cat("\n--- RoB score distribution (ideation / attempts) ---\n")
print(round(prop.table(table(master$rob_score_si)), 3))
print(round(prop.table(table(master$rob_score_at)), 3))
cat("\n--- Delivery format ---\n")
print(count(master, format, combi, family_involvement))
cat("\n--- Control condition ---\n")
print(count(master, condition_arm2_new, control))
```

# 2. Analytic datasets and effect sizes

```{r dataset-construction}
# ── Suicidal ideation ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

numeric_cols_si <- c(
  "n_sessions_arm1", "time_weeks",
  "mean_arm1", "mean_arm2", "sd_arm1", "sd_arm2", "n_arm1", "n_arm2",
  "si_event_arm1", "si_event_arm2", "si_n_arm1", "si_n_arm2",
  "mean_change_arm1", "mean_change_arm2", "sd_change_arm1", "sd_change_arm2",
  "n_change_arm1", "n_change_arm2", "precalc_g", "precalc_g_se"
)

ideation_cols <- c(
  "mean_arm1", "sd_arm1", "mean_arm2", "sd_arm2",
  "si_event_arm1", "si_n_arm1", "si_event_arm2", "si_n_arm2",
  "mean_change_arm1", "sd_change_arm1", "mean_change_arm2", "sd_change_arm2",
  "n_change_arm1", "n_change_arm2", "precalc_g", "precalc_g_se"
)

ideation_raw <- master %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(numeric_cols_si), as.numeric)) %>%
  filter(time == "post") %>%
  filter(if_any(all_of(ideation_cols), ~ !is.na(.))) %>%
  select(-starts_with(c("event_arm1", "event_arm2", "totaln_arm1", "totaln_arm2"))) %>%
  rename(
    event_arm1  = si_event_arm1,
    event_arm2  = si_event_arm2,
    totaln_arm1 = si_n_arm1,
    totaln_arm2 = si_n_arm2
  ) %>%
  mutate(rob_dich = rob_dich_si, rob_score = rob_score_si) %>%
  create_base_id()

inst_freq <- ideation_raw %>%
  filter(!is.na(instrument) & instrument != "NA") %>%
  count(instrument, sort = TRUE) %>%
  rename(inst_freq = n)

# One data format per comparison, in order of preference:
# post-test M/SD > change scores > precalculated g > deterioration (dichotomous)
ideation_raw <- ideation_raw %>%
  mutate(
    outcome_type = case_when(
      !is.na(mean_arm1) & !is.na(sd_arm1) & !is.na(n_arm1) &
      !is.na(mean_arm2) & !is.na(sd_arm2) & !is.na(n_arm2)       ~ "msd",
      !is.na(mean_change_arm1) & !is.na(sd_change_arm1) &
      !is.na(mean_change_arm2) & !is.na(sd_change_arm2)          ~ "change",
      !is.na(precalc_g) & !is.na(precalc_g_se)                   ~ "precalc",
      !is.na(event_arm1) & !is.na(totaln_arm1) & totaln_arm1 > 0 ~ "deterioration",
      TRUE                                                       ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(outcome_type)) %>%
  mutate(   # deterioration counts -> non-deterioration counts
    event_arm1 = if_else(outcome_type == "deterioration", totaln_arm1 - event_arm1, event_arm1),
    event_arm2 = if_else(outcome_type == "deterioration", totaln_arm2 - event_arm2, event_arm2)
  )

# If a comparison reports several instruments, keep the preferred data format,
# then the most frequently used instrument
ideation_post <- ideation_raw %>%
  arrange(study) %>%
  left_join(inst_freq, by = "instrument") %>%
  mutate(
    inst_freq     = ifelse(is.na(inst_freq), 0, inst_freq),
    type_priority = match(outcome_type, c("msd", "change", "precalc", "deterioration"))
  ) %>%
  group_by(base_id) %>%
  arrange(type_priority, desc(inst_freq), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-inst_freq, -type_priority) %>%
  mutate(
    percent_women   = as.numeric(as.character(percent_women)),
    duration_arm1_n = as.numeric(duration_arm1)
  )


# ── Suicide attempts ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

numeric_cols_at <- c(
  "n_sessions_arm1", "time_weeks",
  "mean_arm1", "mean_arm2", "sd_arm1", "sd_arm2", "n_arm1", "n_arm2",
  "event_arm1", "event_arm2", "totaln_arm1", "totaln_arm2"
)

attempts_post <- master %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(numeric_cols_at), as.numeric)) %>%
  filter(str_detect(time, "post")) %>%
  mutate(
    outcome_type    = "RR",
    rob_dich        = rob_dich_at,
    rob_score       = rob_score_at,
    percent_women   = as.numeric(as.character(percent_women)),
    duration_arm1_n = as.numeric(duration_arm1),
    # Sample size from the attempt denominators (totaln_arm1/2); n_arm1/2 refer
    # to the ideation outcome. Falls back to n_arm per arm if missing.
    total_sample    = coalesce(totaln_arm1, n_arm1) + coalesce(totaln_arm2, n_arm2)
  ) %>%
  create_base_id() %>%
  group_by(base_id) %>%
  arrange(is.na(event_arm1), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(event_arm1 > 0 | event_arm2 > 0)   # drop double-zero trials


# ── Variable selection and export ────────────────────────────────────────────

ideation_specific <- c(
  "mean_arm1", "sd_arm1", "mean_arm2", "sd_arm2",
  "event_arm1", "event_arm2", "si_n_arm1", "si_n_arm2",
  "totaln_arm1", "totaln_arm2",
  "mean_change_arm1", "sd_change_arm1", "mean_change_arm2", "sd_change_arm2",
  "n_change_arm1", "n_change_arm2",
  "precalc_g", "precalc_g_se", "n_arm1", "n_arm2", "outcome_type"
)

attempt_specific <- c(
  "event_arm1", "event_arm2", "attempts",
  "suicides_arm1", "suicides_arm2",
  "n_arm1", "n_arm2", "totaln_arm1", "totaln_arm2"
)

ideation_final <- ideation_post %>%
  select(all_of(c(intersect(common_vars, names(.)), intersect(ideation_specific, names(.)))))

attempt_final <- attempts_post %>%
  select(all_of(c(intersect(common_vars, names(.)), intersect(attempt_specific, names(.)))))

save(ideation_final, file = "ideation_data.rda")
save(attempt_final,  file = "attempt_data.rda")
write_xlsx(ideation_final, "ideation.xlsx")
write_xlsx(attempt_final,  "attempt.xlsx")

cat("Ideation comparisons:", nrow(ideation_final), "\n")
cat("Attempt comparisons: ", nrow(attempt_final),  "\n")


# ── Rescaled / centred moderators ────────────────────────────────────────────

rescale_mods <- function(df) {
  df %>% mutate(
    total_n10    = total_sample / 10,
    time_weeks_c = time_weeks    - mean(time_weeks,    na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_women_c  = percent_women - mean(percent_women, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}
ideation_final <- rescale_mods(ideation_final)
attempt_final  <- rescale_mods(attempt_final)


# ── Effect sizes ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Ideation: Hedges' g (negative = favours intervention). Dichotomous outcomes
# are converted from log OR to g (Chinn, 2000). Attempts: log risk ratio.

ideation_msd <- ideation_final %>%
  filter(outcome_type == "msd") %>%
  escalc(measure = "SMD",
         m1i = mean_arm1, sd1i = sd_arm1, n1i = n_arm1,
         m2i = mean_arm2, sd2i = sd_arm2, n2i = n_arm2, data = .)

ideation_change <- ideation_final %>%
  filter(outcome_type == "change") %>%
  escalc(measure = "SMD",
         m1i = mean_change_arm1, sd1i = sd_change_arm1, n1i = n_change_arm1,
         m2i = mean_change_arm2, sd2i = sd_change_arm2, n2i = n_change_arm2,
         data = .)

ideation_precalc <- ideation_final %>%
  filter(outcome_type == "precalc") %>%
  mutate(yi = precalc_g, vi = precalc_g_se^2)

ideation_dich <- ideation_final %>%
  filter(outcome_type == "deterioration") %>%
  escalc(measure = "OR",
         ai = event_arm1, n1i = totaln_arm1,
         ci = event_arm2, n2i = totaln_arm2, data = .) %>%
  mutate(yi = -yi * sqrt(3) / pi,
         vi = vi * 3 / pi^2)

ideation_final <- bind_rows(ideation_msd, ideation_change, ideation_precalc, ideation_dich) %>%
  mutate(sei = sqrt(vi)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(yi) & !is.na(sei))

stopifnot(nrow(ideation_final) ==
          sum(!is.na(ideation_msd$yi), !is.na(ideation_change$yi),
              !is.na(ideation_precalc$yi), !is.na(ideation_dich$yi)))

attempt_final <- attempt_final %>%
  mutate(
    totaln_arm1 = coalesce(as.numeric(totaln_arm1), as.numeric(n_arm1)),
    totaln_arm2 = coalesce(as.numeric(totaln_arm2), as.numeric(n_arm2))
  ) %>%
  escalc(measure = "RR",
         ai = event_arm1, n1i = totaln_arm1,
         ci = event_arm2, n2i = totaln_arm2, data = .) %>%
  mutate(sei = sqrt(vi)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(yi) & !is.na(sei))

ideation_final$rob_dich <- factor(ideation_final$rob_dich, levels = c("low_some", "high"))
attempt_final$rob_dich  <- factor(attempt_final$rob_dich,  levels = c("low_some", "high"))

cat("Ideation comparisons with effect size:", nrow(ideation_final), "\n")
cat("Attempt comparisons with effect size: ", nrow(attempt_final),  "\n")
```

# 3. Publication bias

```{r publication-bias}
# Egger's regression test (classical weighted regression on the SE). The
# bias-adjusted estimate is the Egger regression intercept, i.e. the predicted
# effect at SE = 0.

run_limit_manual <- function(data, label) {
  m   <- rma(yi, vi, data = data, method = "REML", control = list(optimizer = "nlminb"))
  fit <- regtest(m, model = "lm", predictor = "sei")$fit
  est <- coef(fit)[1]
  se  <- summary(fit)$coefficients[1, "Std. Error"]
  ci  <- est + c(-1, 1) * 1.96 * se
  cat(sprintf("%-12s k = %3d  pooled = %.3f  adjusted = %.3f [%.3f, %.3f]\n",
              label, nrow(data), m$beta, est, ci[1], ci[2]))
  invisible(list(pooled = as.numeric(m$beta), estimate = est, se = se, ci = ci))
}

egger_si <- rma(yi, sei = sei, data = ideation_final, method = "REML",
                control = list(optimizer = "nlminb"))
egger_at <- rma(yi, sei = sei, data = attempt_final, method = "REML",
                control = list(optimizer = "nlminb"))
rt_si <- regtest(egger_si, model = "lm", predictor = "sei")
rt_at <- regtest(egger_at, model = "lm", predictor = "sei")

cat("--- Egger's test: ideation ---\n");  print(rt_si)
cat("--- Egger's test: attempts ---\n");  print(rt_at)

lim_si <- run_limit_manual(ideation_final, "Ideation")
lim_at <- run_limit_manual(attempt_final,  "Attempts")

pub_bias_summary <- tibble(
  outcome   = c("Suicidal ideation", "Suicide attempts"),
  k         = c(nrow(ideation_final), nrow(attempt_final)),
  pooled    = c(lim_si$pooled, lim_at$pooled),
  egger_z   = c(rt_si$zval, rt_at$zval),
  egger_p   = c(rt_si$pval, rt_at$pval),
  limit_est = c(lim_si$estimate, lim_at$estimate),
  limit_lb  = c(lim_si$ci[1], lim_at$ci[1]),
  limit_ub  = c(lim_si$ci[2], lim_at$ci[2])
)
write.csv(pub_bias_summary, "publication_bias_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r publication-bias-income}
# Does the ideation small-study effect reflect the income-level difference?
# (1) Egger's test and adjusted estimate within HIC and LMIC comparisons,
# (2) whether the SE slope changes when income level is added, and whether it
#     differs by income level (interaction).

for (g in c("hic", "lmic")) {
  d <- filter(ideation_final, lmic == g)
  m <- rma(yi, sei = sei, data = d, method = "REML", control = list(optimizer = "nlminb"))
  cat("---", toupper(g), " k =", nrow(d), "---\n")
  print(regtest(m, model = "lm", predictor = "sei"))
}

lim_hic  <- run_limit_manual(filter(ideation_final, lmic == "hic"),  "HIC only")
lim_lmic <- run_limit_manual(filter(ideation_final, lmic == "lmic"), "LMIC only")

attenuation <- function(l) 100 * (1 - l$estimate / l$pooled)
cat(sprintf("\nAttenuation: full = %.1f%%  HIC = %.1f%%  LMIC = %.1f%%\n",
            attenuation(lim_si), attenuation(lim_hic), attenuation(lim_lmic)))

ctrl <- list(optimizer = "nlminb")
m_sei_only <- rma(yi, vi, mods = ~ sei,        data = ideation_final, method = "REML", control = ctrl)
m_sei_lmic <- rma(yi, vi, mods = ~ sei + lmic, data = ideation_final, method = "REML", control = ctrl)
m_interact <- rma(yi, vi, mods = ~ sei * lmic, data = ideation_final, method = "REML", control = ctrl)

print(m_sei_only); print(m_sei_lmic); print(m_interact)
cat(sprintf("\nSE coefficient: %.3f alone vs. %.3f adjusted for income level (%.0f%% reduction)\n",
            m_sei_only$beta[2], m_sei_lmic$beta[2],
            100 * (1 - m_sei_lmic$beta[2] / m_sei_only$beta[2])))

ideation_final %>% group_by(lmic) %>%
  summarise(k = n(),
            median_n   = median(total_sample, na.rm = TRUE),
            median_sei = round(median(sei), 3),
            mean_yi    = round(mean(yi), 3)) %>%
  print()

save(egger_si, egger_at, lim_si, lim_at, lim_hic, lim_lmic, pub_bias_summary,
     m_sei_only, m_sei_lmic, m_interact,
     file = "publication_bias_results.rda")
```

# 4. Univariate location-scale models

```{r univariate-analysis}
# ── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

NULL_F  <- ~ 1
ROB_VAR <- "rob_score"

# Fit a location-scale model, trying several optimizers in turn. A fit counts
# as converged only if all coefficients and SEs are finite and SEs < se_threshold.
# scale_f = NULL (suicide attempts): location-only model, fitted as a standard
# random-effects meta-regression. This is the same model as a location-scale
# model with an intercept-only scale (identical likelihood, AICc and estimates),
# but avoids failures of the location-scale starting values when a moderator
# level contains a single comparison or tau^2 is estimated at zero.
fit_lsm <- function(loc_f, scale_f, data, method = "ML", se_threshold = 100) {
  opts <- list(
    list(optimizer = "nlminb"),
    list(optimizer = "optim", optmethod = "Nelder-Mead"),
    list(optimizer = "optim", optmethod = "BFGS"),
    list(optimizer = "nloptr")
  )
  for (ctrl in opts) {
    fit <- suppressWarnings(tryCatch(
      if (is.null(scale_f)) {
        rma(yi, sei = sei, mods = loc_f, data = data, method = method, test = "knha")
      } else {
        rma(yi, sei = sei, mods = loc_f, scale = scale_f, data = data,
            method = method, test = "knha", control = ctrl)
      },
      error = function(e) NULL))
    ok <- !is.null(fit) &&
          all(is.finite(c(fit$beta, fit$se))) &&
          all(fit$se < se_threshold) &&
          (is.null(fit$alpha) ||
           (all(is.finite(c(fit$alpha, fit$se.alpha))) && all(fit$se.alpha < se_threshold)))
    if (isTRUE(ok)) {
      attr(fit, "optimizer") <- paste(unlist(ctrl), collapse = "-")
      return(fit)
    }
  }
  NULL
}

get_aicc <- function(m) if (is.null(m)) NA_real_ else summary(m)$fit.stats["AICc", "ML"]


# ── Overall effect and heterogeneity ─────────────────────────────────────────

null_si <- rma(yi, sei = sei, data = ideation_final, method = "REML", test = "knha")
null_at <- rma(yi, sei = sei, data = attempt_final,  method = "REML", test = "knha")

for (nm in c("Ideation", "Attempt")) {
  m <- if (nm == "Ideation") null_si else null_at
  cat(sprintf("%-9s estimate = %.4f  tau2 = %.4f  I2 = %.1f%%  Q(%d) = %.1f  p = %s\n",
              nm, m$beta, m$tau2, m$I2, m$k - 1, m$QE, format.pval(m$QEp, digits = 3)))
}

# Scale component modelled for ideation only (see Overview, point 2)
model_scale <- list(ideation = TRUE, attempt = FALSE)


# ── Candidate moderators ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

moderator_info <- tribble(
  ~name,                ~type,        ~domain,
  "total_n10",          "continuous", "Study design and conduct",
  "control",            "factor",     "Study design and conduct",
  "time_weeks_c",       "continuous", "Study design and conduct",
  "lmic",               "factor",     "Study design and conduct",
  "direct",             "factor",     "Intervention",
  "combi",              "factor",     "Intervention",
  "family_involvement", "factor",     "Intervention",
  "duration_arm1_n",    "continuous", "Intervention",
  "disorder_suic",      "factor",     "Population",
  "age_dich",           "factor",     "Population",
  "pct_women_c",        "continuous", "Population",
  "rob_score",          "continuous", "Covariate"
)


# ── Univariate models ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Moderator + RoB score in location (and scale, if modelled), on the
# moderator's own complete cases. adjust_rob = FALSE drops the RoB covariate
# (sensitivity analysis A).

fit_univariate <- function(data, moderator, type, rob_var = ROB_VAR,
                           with_scale = TRUE, min_per_level = 4, adjust_rob = TRUE) {
  vars <- c("yi", "sei", moderator, if (adjust_rob) rob_var)
  sub  <- data %>% select(all_of(unique(vars))) %>% drop_na()

  if (nrow(sub) < 10) {
    message("Skipping ", moderator, ": fewer than 10 comparisons.")
    return(NULL)
  }
  if (type == "factor") {
    sub[[moderator]] <- droplevels(factor(sub[[moderator]]))
    tab <- table(sub[[moderator]])
    if (length(tab) < 2 || any(tab < min_per_level)) {
      message("Skipping ", moderator, ": a level has fewer than ", min_per_level, " comparisons.")
      return(NULL)
    }
  }

  rhs <- if (!adjust_rob || moderator == rob_var) moderator else paste(moderator, "+", rob_var)
  loc_f   <- as.formula(paste("~", rhs))
  scale_f <- if (with_scale) loc_f else NULL

  fit <- fit_lsm(loc_f, scale_f, sub, method = "REML")
  if (is.null(fit)) {
    message("Model for ", moderator, " did not converge.")
    return(NULL)
  }
  list(fit = fit, data = sub, moderator = moderator, type = type,
       loc_f = loc_f, scale_f = scale_f, with_scale = with_scale,
       rob_var = rob_var, adjust_rob = adjust_rob)
}

run_univariate <- function(data, label, with_scale) {
  cat("\n=====", label, "=====\n")
  res <- pmap(list(moderator = moderator_info$name, type = moderator_info$type),
              function(moderator, type) fit_univariate(data, moderator, type, with_scale = with_scale))
  names(res) <- moderator_info$name
  res <- compact(res)
  cat("Estimated:", length(res), "of", nrow(moderator_info), "\n")
  not_run <- setdiff(moderator_info$name, names(res))
  if (length(not_run)) cat("Not estimated:", paste(not_run, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  res
}

uni_si <- run_univariate(ideation_final, "Suicidal ideation", model_scale$ideation)
uni_at <- run_univariate(attempt_final,  "Suicide attempts",  model_scale$attempt)


# ── Likelihood ratio tests (ML): moderator + RoB vs. RoB only ────────────────

lrt_lsm <- function(res) {
  if (is.null(res) || res$moderator == res$rob_var) return(NULL)
  d     <- res$data
  rob_f <- as.formula(paste("~", res$rob_var))

  full <- fit_lsm(res$loc_f, res$scale_f, d, method = "ML")
  if (is.null(full)) return(NULL)
  base <- fit_lsm(rob_f, if (res$with_scale) rob_f else NULL, d, method = "ML")
  if (is.null(base))
    return(list(moderator = res$moderator, k = nrow(d), omni_df = NA_real_, omni_p = NA_real_))

  a <- anova(full, base)
  list(moderator = res$moderator, k = nrow(d), omni_df = a$parms.f - a$parms.r, omni_p = a$pval)
}

lrt_si <- compact(map(uni_si, lrt_lsm))
lrt_at <- compact(map(uni_at, lrt_lsm))

cat("\n--- LRT: ideation ---\n"); print(bind_rows(lrt_si) %>% mutate(omni_p = signif(omni_p, 3)), n = Inf)
cat("\n--- LRT: attempts ---\n"); print(bind_rows(lrt_at) %>% mutate(omni_p = signif(omni_p, 3)), n = Inf)


# ── Coefficients: Wald CIs for beta, profile-likelihood CIs for alpha ────────

extract_coefs <- function(res) {
  if (is.null(res)) return(NULL)
  f <- res$fit
  loc <- tibble(moderator = res$moderator, component = "location",
                term = rownames(f$beta), estimate = as.numeric(f$beta),
                ci.lb = f$ci.lb, ci.ub = f$ci.ub, stat = f$zval, p = f$pval)
  if (is.null(f$alpha)) return(loc)

  sc <- tibble(moderator = res$moderator, component = "scale",
               term = rownames(f$alpha), estimate = as.numeric(f$alpha),
               stat = f$zval.alpha, p = f$pval.alpha,
               ci.lb = f$ci.lb.alpha, ci.ub = f$ci.ub.alpha)   # Wald fallback

  pci <- tryCatch(confint(f), error = function(e) NULL)
  prof <- if (is.null(pci)) NULL else tryCatch(
    do.call(rbind, lapply(pci[sapply(pci, function(x) is.list(x) && !is.null(x$random))],
                          function(x) x$random)),
    error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(prof) && nrow(prof) == nrow(sc)) {
    sc$ci.lb <- prof[, "ci.lb"]
    sc$ci.ub <- prof[, "ci.ub"]
  } else {
    message("Profile-likelihood CI unavailable for ", res$moderator, "; using Wald CI.")
  }
  bind_rows(loc, sc)
}

coefs_si <- map_dfr(uni_si, extract_coefs)
coefs_at <- map_dfr(uni_at, extract_coefs)

cat("\n--- Coefficients: ideation ---\n")
print(coefs_si %>% filter(!grepl("intrcpt", term)) %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 4))), n = Inf)
cat("\n--- Coefficients: attempts ---\n")
print(coefs_at %>% filter(!grepl("intrcpt", term)) %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 4))), n = Inf)


# ── Permutation tests ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# For moderators significant in the LRT or any Wald test: permute the
# moderator across comparisons, refit, and compare the largest |z| of the
# moderator's coefficients against its permutation distribution.

permutation_test <- function(data, moderator, with_scale, n_perm = 1000,
                             rob_var = ROB_VAR, seed = 2026) {
  set.seed(seed)
  sub <- data %>% select(all_of(c("yi", "sei", moderator, rob_var))) %>% drop_na()
  loc_f   <- as.formula(paste("~", moderator, "+", rob_var))
  scale_f <- if (with_scale) loc_f else NULL

  obs <- fit_lsm(loc_f, scale_f, sub, method = "REML")
  if (is.null(obs)) return(NULL)

  stat_of <- function(m) {
    idx_loc <- grep(paste0("^", moderator), rownames(m$beta))
    s_loc <- if (length(idx_loc)) max(abs(m$zval[idx_loc])) else NA_real_
    if (is.null(m$alpha)) return(c(location = s_loc, scale = NA_real_))
    idx_sc <- grep(paste0("^", moderator), rownames(m$alpha))
    s_sc <- if (length(idx_sc)) max(abs(m$zval.alpha[idx_sc])) else NA_real_
    c(location = s_loc, scale = s_sc)
  }

  obs_stat  <- stat_of(obs)
  null_stat <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = n_perm, ncol = 2,
                      dimnames = list(NULL, c("location", "scale")))
  for (i in seq_len(n_perm)) {
    perm <- sub
    perm[[moderator]] <- sample(perm[[moderator]])
    m <- fit_lsm(loc_f, scale_f, perm, method = "REML")
    if (!is.null(m)) null_stat[i, ] <- stat_of(m)
  }

  tibble(
    moderator    = moderator, k = nrow(sub),
    stat_loc     = obs_stat["location"],
    p_perm_loc   = mean(null_stat[, "location"] >= obs_stat["location"], na.rm = TRUE),
    stat_scale   = obs_stat["scale"],
    p_perm_scale = if (with_scale) mean(null_stat[, "scale"] >= obs_stat["scale"], na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
    n_converged  = sum(!is.na(null_stat[, 1]))
  )
}

flag_for_permutation <- function(lrt_list, coefs) {
  lrt_flagged  <- bind_rows(lrt_list) %>% filter(omni_p < .05) %>% pull(moderator)
  wald_flagged <- coefs %>%
    filter(!grepl("intrcpt", term), !grepl(paste0("^", ROB_VAR), term), p < .05) %>%
    pull(moderator)
  intersect(moderator_info$name, union(lrt_flagged, wald_flagged))
}

perm_candidates_si <- flag_for_permutation(lrt_si, coefs_si)
perm_candidates_at <- flag_for_permutation(lrt_at, coefs_at)
cat("\nPermutation tests for (ideation):", paste(perm_candidates_si, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Permutation tests for (attempts):",   paste(perm_candidates_at, collapse = ", "), "\n")

perm_si <- map_dfr(perm_candidates_si, ~ permutation_test(ideation_final, .x, model_scale$ideation))
perm_at <- map_dfr(perm_candidates_at, ~ permutation_test(attempt_final,  .x, model_scale$attempt))

print(perm_si %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 4))), n = Inf)
print(perm_at %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 4))), n = Inf)

save(null_si, null_at, uni_si, uni_at, lrt_si, lrt_at, coefs_si, coefs_at,
     perm_si, perm_at, perm_candidates_si, perm_candidates_at,
     file = "univariate_results.rda")
```

# 5. Multi-model selection

```{r multimodel-selection}
# ── Candidate set and analytic sample ────────────────────────────────────────
# Family involvement is examined in univariate models only (overlaps with
# delivery format and age group); the remaining 11 moderators, including RoB
# score, are candidates. All candidate models are fitted on the same
# complete-case sample so that AICc values are comparable.

MM_EXCLUDE <- "family_involvement"
full_mods  <- setdiff(moderator_info$name, MM_EXCLUDE)
MAX_SIZE   <- 4

mm_data_si <- ideation_final %>% drop_na(all_of(full_mods))
mm_data_at <- attempt_final  %>% drop_na(all_of(full_mods))

cat("Candidates (", length(full_mods), "):", paste(full_mods, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Ideation analytic sample:", nrow(mm_data_si), "of", nrow(ideation_final), "\n")
cat("Attempt analytic sample: ", nrow(mm_data_at), "of", nrow(attempt_final),  "\n")
cat("\nMissing values per candidate moderator (ideation / attempts):\n")
print(rbind(ideation = colSums(is.na(ideation_final[full_mods])),
            attempt  = colSums(is.na(attempt_final[full_mods]))))


# ── Collinearity screening ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Association on a common 0-1 scale: |r| (continuous x continuous), Cramér's V
# (factor x factor), correlation ratio sqrt(eta^2) (factor x continuous).
# Pairs at or above the a priori threshold may not enter the same model.

COLLIN_THRESHOLD <- 0.6

assoc_strength <- function(x, y) {
  x_num <- is.numeric(x); y_num <- is.numeric(y)
  if (x_num && y_num) return(abs(suppressWarnings(cor(x, y, use = "pairwise.complete.obs"))))
  if (!x_num && !y_num) {
    tab <- table(droplevels(factor(x)), droplevels(factor(y)))
    if (any(dim(tab) < 2)) return(NA_real_)
    chi <- suppressWarnings(chisq.test(tab, correct = FALSE))
    return(sqrt(as.numeric(chi$statistic) / (sum(tab) * (min(dim(tab)) - 1))))
  }
  if (x_num) { cont <- x; grp <- y } else { cont <- y; grp <- x }
  grp <- droplevels(factor(grp))
  if (nlevels(grp) < 2) return(NA_real_)
  fit <- tryCatch(aov(cont ~ grp), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(fit)) return(NA_real_)
  ss <- summary(fit)[[1]][["Sum Sq"]]
  sqrt(ss[1] / sum(ss))
}

find_collinear_pairs <- function(data, mods, threshold = COLLIN_THRESHOLD) {
  map_dfr(combn(mods, 2, simplify = FALSE), function(p) {
    sub <- data %>% select(all_of(p)) %>% drop_na()
    v <- tryCatch(assoc_strength(sub[[p[1]]], sub[[p[2]]]), error = function(e) NA_real_)
    tibble(var1 = p[1], var2 = p[2], k = nrow(sub), assoc = v)
  }) %>% filter(!is.na(assoc) & assoc >= threshold) %>% arrange(desc(assoc))
}

collin_si <- find_collinear_pairs(mm_data_si, full_mods)
collin_at <- find_collinear_pairs(mm_data_at, full_mods)
cat("\n--- Excluded pairs (ideation) ---\n"); print(collin_si)
cat("\n--- Excluded pairs (attempts) ---\n"); print(collin_at)

pairs_to_list <- function(tab) lapply(seq_len(nrow(tab)), function(i) c(tab$var1[i], tab$var2[i]))
exclude_pairs_si <- pairs_to_list(collin_si)
exclude_pairs_at <- pairs_to_list(collin_at)


# ── Model space, fitting and averaging ───────────────────────────────────────

# All combinations of 0..max_size moderators, minus those containing an
# excluded pair. `force` adds variables to every model (sensitivity analysis B).
# Location and scale always receive the same moderators.
build_formulas <- function(mods, max_size, with_scale = TRUE, exclude_pairs = list(),
                           force = character(0)) {
  combos <- unlist(lapply(0:min(max_size, length(mods)), function(s)
    if (s == 0) list(character(0)) else combn(mods, s, simplify = FALSE)), recursive = FALSE)

  if (length(exclude_pairs)) {
    keep <- vapply(combos, function(cm) {
      vars <- union(cm, force)
      !any(vapply(exclude_pairs, function(pr) all(pr %in% vars), logical(1)))
    }, logical(1))
    combos <- combos[keep]
  }

  lapply(combos, function(cm) {
    terms <- c(cm, force)
    loc   <- if (length(terms)) as.formula(paste("~", paste(terms, collapse = " + "))) else NULL_F
    list(loc = loc, scale = if (with_scale) loc else NULL, mods = cm)
  })
}

fit_all <- function(fp, data, label) {
  fits <- lapply(fp, function(f) fit_lsm(f$loc, f$scale, data, method = "ML"))
  keep <- !vapply(fits, is.null, logical(1))
  cat(sprintf("%-32s converged %4d / %4d  (k = %d)\n", label, sum(keep), length(fp), nrow(data)))
  list(fits = fits[keep], fp = fp[keep], n_total = length(fp),
       n_converged = sum(keep), failed_fp = fp[!keep])
}

akaike_weights <- function(aicc) {
  w <- exp(-(aicc - min(aicc, na.rm = TRUE)) / 2)
  w / sum(w, na.rm = TRUE)
}

# Full model averaging: coefficients absent from a model count as 0.
# Unconditional SE (Burnham & Anderson, 2002); Wald z/p as in Kuper et al. (2025),
# not adjusted for model selection.
model_average <- function(fits, weights) {
  params <- unique(unlist(lapply(fits, function(m)
    c(paste0("loc_", rownames(m$beta)), if (!is.null(m$alpha)) paste0("scale_", rownames(m$alpha))))))

  coef_mat    <- matrix(0, length(fits), length(params), dimnames = list(NULL, params))
  se_mat      <- coef_mat
  present_mat <- matrix(FALSE, length(fits), length(params), dimnames = list(NULL, params))

  for (i in seq_along(fits)) {
    m  <- fits[[i]]
    lp <- paste0("loc_", rownames(m$beta))
    coef_mat[i, lp] <- as.numeric(m$beta); se_mat[i, lp] <- m$se; present_mat[i, lp] <- TRUE
    if (!is.null(m$alpha)) {
      sp <- paste0("scale_", rownames(m$alpha))
      coef_mat[i, sp] <- as.numeric(m$alpha); se_mat[i, sp] <- m$se.alpha; present_mat[i, sp] <- TRUE
    }
  }

  avg    <- colSums(weights * coef_mat)
  avg_se <- sqrt(colSums(weights * (se_mat^2 + sweep(coef_mat, 2, avg, "-")^2)))
  z      <- avg / avg_se

  tibble(parameter = params, estimate = avg, se = avg_se, z = z,
         p = 2 * pnorm(-abs(z)),
         ci.lb = avg - 1.96 * avg_se, ci.ub = avg + 1.96 * avg_se,
         importance = colSums(weights * present_mat)) %>%
    arrange(desc(importance), parameter)
}

run_multimodel <- function(data, mods, label, with_scale, max_size = MAX_SIZE,
                           exclude_pairs = list(), force = character(0)) {
  fp  <- build_formulas(mods, max_size, with_scale, exclude_pairs, force)
  res <- fit_all(fp, data, label)
  if (res$n_converged == 0) return(NULL)
  aicc <- vapply(res$fits, get_aicc, numeric(1))
  w    <- akaike_weights(aicc)
  list(avg = model_average(res$fits, w), weights = w, aicc = aicc,
       res = res, data = data, fp = fp, label = label)
}

rank_models_tbl <- function(mm, n_show = 10) {
  delta <- mm$aicc - min(mm$aicc, na.rm = TRUE)
  tibble(moderators = vapply(mm$res$fp, function(f)
           if (length(f$mods)) paste(f$mods, collapse = " + ") else "(intercept only)", character(1)),
         aicc = round(mm$aicc, 2), delta = round(delta, 2), weight = round(mm$weights, 4)) %>%
    arrange(delta) %>% mutate(rank = row_number(), .before = 1) %>%
    slice_head(n = n_show)
}

print_mm <- function(mm) {
  delta <- mm$aicc - min(mm$aicc, na.rm = TRUE)
  cat("\n---", mm$label, "---\n")
  print(rank_models_tbl(mm), n = Inf)
  cat("Models within 2 AICc units of the best:", sum(delta <= 2, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
  print(mm$avg %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 4))), n = Inf)
}


# ── Primary analysis ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

mm_si <- run_multimodel(mm_data_si, full_mods, "Ideation, primary",
                        with_scale = model_scale$ideation, exclude_pairs = exclude_pairs_si)
mm_at <- run_multimodel(mm_data_at, full_mods, "Attempts, primary",
                        with_scale = model_scale$attempt, exclude_pairs = exclude_pairs_at)
print_mm(mm_si)
print_mm(mm_at)

save(mm_si, mm_at, collin_si, collin_at, exclude_pairs_si, exclude_pairs_at, full_mods,
     file = "multimodel_results.rda")
```

# 6. Sensitivity analyses

```{r sensitivity-rob}
# ── A. Univariate models with vs. without RoB adjustment ─────────────────────

# The moderator's own coefficient: row 2 of beta/alpha (for factors, the
# first non-reference level).
own_coef <- function(res) {
  if (is.null(res)) return(NULL)
  f <- res$fit
  out <- tibble(moderator = res$moderator, component = "location",
                term = rownames(f$beta)[2], estimate = f$beta[2], se = f$se[2], p = f$pval[2])
  if (!is.null(f$alpha))
    out <- bind_rows(out, tibble(moderator = res$moderator, component = "scale",
                                 term = rownames(f$alpha)[2], estimate = f$alpha[2],
                                 se = f$se.alpha[2], p = f$pval.alpha[2]))
  out
}

compare_wide <- function(tab, a, b) {
  tab %>%
    select(moderator, component, spec, estimate, se, p) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = spec, values_from = c(estimate, se, p)) %>%
    mutate(delta_estimate = .data[[paste0("estimate_", a)]] - .data[[paste0("estimate_", b)]],
           pct_change = round(100 * delta_estimate / abs(.data[[paste0("estimate_", b)]]), 1))
}

run_rob_sensitivity_univariate <- function(data, with_scale) {
  tag <- function(x, spec) if (is.null(x)) NULL else mutate(x, spec = spec)
  map2_dfr(moderator_info$name, moderator_info$type, function(moderator, type) {
    if (moderator == ROB_VAR) return(NULL)   # moderators not estimable are skipped
    bind_rows(
      tag(own_coef(fit_univariate(data, moderator, type, with_scale = with_scale, adjust_rob = TRUE)),
          "with_RoB"),
      tag(own_coef(fit_univariate(data, moderator, type, with_scale = with_scale, adjust_rob = FALSE)),
          "without_RoB"))
  })
}

uni_rob_sens_si <- run_rob_sensitivity_univariate(ideation_final, model_scale$ideation)
uni_rob_sens_at <- run_rob_sensitivity_univariate(attempt_final,  model_scale$attempt)

cat("\n--- Ideation: with vs. without RoB ---\n")
print(compare_wide(uni_rob_sens_si, "with_RoB", "without_RoB") %>%
        mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 4))), n = Inf)
cat("\n--- Attempts: with vs. without RoB ---\n")
print(compare_wide(uni_rob_sens_at, "with_RoB", "without_RoB") %>%
        mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 4))), n = Inf)


# ── B. Multi-model selection with RoB forced into every model ────────────────
# Same analytic sample and excluded pairs as the primary analysis.

mods_substantive <- setdiff(full_mods, ROB_VAR)

mm_si_forced <- run_multimodel(mm_data_si, mods_substantive, "Ideation, RoB forced",
                               with_scale = model_scale$ideation,
                               exclude_pairs = exclude_pairs_si, force = ROB_VAR)
mm_at_forced <- run_multimodel(mm_data_at, mods_substantive, "Attempts, RoB forced",
                               with_scale = model_scale$attempt,
                               exclude_pairs = exclude_pairs_at, force = ROB_VAR)

# Compare two multi-model fits on estimate, importance and p
compare_multimodel <- function(mm_a, mm_b, a = "primary", b = "alt", drop = NULL) {
  pick <- function(mm, s) {
    d <- mm$avg
    if (!is.null(drop)) d <- filter(d, !grepl(drop, parameter))
    d %>% select(parameter, estimate, importance, p) %>%
      rename_with(~ paste0(., "_", s), -parameter)
  }
  full_join(pick(mm_a, a), pick(mm_b, b), by = "parameter") %>%
    mutate(d_importance = round(.data[[paste0("importance_", b)]] - .data[[paste0("importance_", a)]], 3)) %>%
    arrange(desc(pmax(.data[[paste0("importance_", a)]], .data[[paste0("importance_", b)]], na.rm = TRUE)))
}

# RoB score itself is excluded (importance = 1 by construction when forced)
cmp_si <- compare_multimodel(mm_si, mm_si_forced, "compete", "forced", drop = ROB_VAR)
cmp_at <- compare_multimodel(mm_at, mm_at_forced, "compete", "forced", drop = ROB_VAR)
print(cmp_si %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 4))), n = Inf)
print(cmp_at %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 4))), n = Inf)

save(uni_rob_sens_si, uni_rob_sens_at, mm_si_forced, mm_at_forced, cmp_si, cmp_at,
     file = "sensitivity_rob_results.rda")
```

```{r sensitivity-influence-outliers}
# Influential cases and outliers are identified once, from the moderator-free
# model of each outcome. Both stages are then refitted without them.
#   C. Influential: metafor::influence() default rule (Viechtbauer & Cheung, 2010)
#   D. Outliers:    |externally studentized residual| > 3

# Univariate stage: refit the moderators estimated in the primary analysis
compare_own_coef <- function(fit_list_full, data_reduced, with_scale) {
  full <- map_dfr(fit_list_full, own_coef) %>% mutate(spec = "full")
  excl <- map_dfr(names(fit_list_full), function(m) {
    type <- moderator_info$type[moderator_info$name == m]
    own_coef(fit_univariate(data_reduced, m, type, with_scale = with_scale))
  })
  if (nrow(excl) == 0) {
    message("No univariate model could be refitted after exclusion.")
    return(NULL)
  }
  compare_wide(bind_rows(full, mutate(excl, spec = "excluded")), "excluded", "full")
}

run_exclusion_sensitivity <- function(data, flag, uni_fit_list, with_scale, exclude_pairs, label) {
  if (sum(flag, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) {
    cat("\n", label, ": no comparisons flagged; identical to primary analysis, skipped.\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  data_reduced <- data[!flag, ]
  cat("\n", label, ": excluded", sum(flag), "->", paste(data$study[flag], collapse = "; "), "\n")
  list(
    uni = compare_own_coef(uni_fit_list, data_reduced, with_scale),
    mm  = run_multimodel(drop_na(data_reduced, all_of(full_mods)), full_mods, label,
                         with_scale = with_scale, exclude_pairs = exclude_pairs)
  )
}

infl_si <- influence(null_si)
infl_at <- influence(null_at)

infl_flag_si <- infl_si$is.infl
infl_flag_at <- infl_at$is.infl
out_flag_si  <- abs(infl_si$inf$rstudent) > 3
out_flag_at  <- abs(infl_at$inf$rstudent) > 3
out_flag_si[is.na(out_flag_si)] <- FALSE
out_flag_at[is.na(out_flag_at)] <- FALSE

sens_infl_si <- run_exclusion_sensitivity(ideation_final, infl_flag_si, uni_si, model_scale$ideation,
                                          exclude_pairs_si, "Ideation, excl. influential")
sens_infl_at <- run_exclusion_sensitivity(attempt_final,  infl_flag_at, uni_at, model_scale$attempt,
                                          exclude_pairs_at, "Attempts, excl. influential")
sens_out_si  <- run_exclusion_sensitivity(ideation_final, out_flag_si,  uni_si, model_scale$ideation,
                                          exclude_pairs_si, "Ideation, excl. outliers")
sens_out_at  <- run_exclusion_sensitivity(attempt_final,  out_flag_at,  uni_at, model_scale$attempt,
                                          exclude_pairs_at, "Attempts, excl. outliers")

mm_si_excl_infl <- sens_infl_si$mm
mm_at_excl_infl <- sens_infl_at$mm

show_sens <- function(sens, mm_primary) {
  if (is.null(sens)) return(invisible(NULL))
  if (!is.null(sens$uni)) print(sens$uni %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 4))), n = Inf)
  if (is.null(sens$mm)) return(invisible(NULL))
  cmp <- compare_multimodel(mm_primary, sens$mm, "full", "excluded")
  print(cmp %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 4))), n = Inf)
  invisible(cmp)
}

cmp_infl_mm_si <- show_sens(sens_infl_si, mm_si)
cmp_infl_mm_at <- show_sens(sens_infl_at, mm_at)
cmp_out_mm_si  <- show_sens(sens_out_si,  mm_si)
cmp_out_mm_at  <- show_sens(sens_out_at,  mm_at)

save(infl_flag_si, infl_flag_at, out_flag_si, out_flag_at,
     sens_infl_si, sens_infl_at, sens_out_si, sens_out_at,
     mm_si_excl_infl, mm_at_excl_infl,
     cmp_infl_mm_si, cmp_infl_mm_at, cmp_out_mm_si, cmp_out_mm_at,
     file = "sensitivity_influence_outlier_results.rda")
```

```{r visualization-setup}
theme_lsm <- theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),

tbl_grob <- function(tab, size = 8) {

    core = list(fg_params = list(fontsize = size)),

# ── RoB summary ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ROB_LABELS <- c("D1: Randomization Process", "D2: Intervention Deviations", "D3: Missing Data",
                "D4: Outcome Measurement", "D5: Selective Outcome Reporting")

plot_rob_summary <- function(master, ids, domain_cols, overall_col, title) {
  sub <- master %>% filter(id %in% ids) %>% select(id, all_of(domain_cols), Overall = all_of(overall_col))
  long <- sub %>%
    pivot_longer(-id, names_to = "domain", values_to = "rating") %>%
    mutate(domain = recode(domain, !!!setNames(ROB_LABELS, domain_cols)),
           domain = factor(domain, levels = rev(c(ROB_LABELS, "Overall"))),
           rating = factor(rating, levels = c("low", "some concerns", "high"),
                           labels = c("Low risk", "Some concerns", "High risk")))
  summ <- long %>% filter(!is.na(rating)) %>% count(domain, rating) %>%
    group_by(domain) %>% mutate(pct = n / sum(n) * 100) %>% ungroup()
  ggplot(summ, aes(x = domain, y = pct, fill = rating)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.7, color = "white") +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Low risk" = "#2ca25f", "Some concerns" = "#fdae61",
                                 "High risk" = "#d73027"), name = NULL) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%"), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    labs(title = title, subtitle = paste0("k = ", n_distinct(sub$id), " studies"),
         x = NULL, y = "Percent of studies") +
    theme_lsm + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
}

# ── Funnel plots ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
plot_funnel <- function(data, pooled, title, subtitle = NULL, by_income = FALSE) {
  se_max <- max(data$sei, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.05
  se_seq <- seq(0, se_max, length.out = 100)
  fdf    <- tibble(se = se_seq, lo = pooled - 1.96 * se_seq, hi = pooled + 1.96 * se_seq)
  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_path(data = fdf, aes(x = lo, y = se), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey55") +
    geom_path(data = fdf, aes(x = hi, y = se), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey55") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = pooled, color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.5)
  p <- if (by_income) {
    p + geom_point(data = data, aes(x = yi, y = sei, fill = lmic), shape = 21, color = "grey20",
                   alpha = 0.8, size = 2.2) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c(hic = "#2a78d6", lmic = "#eb6834"), name = "Income level",
                        labels = c(hic = "HIC", lmic = "LMIC"), na.translate = FALSE)
  } else {
    p + geom_point(data = data, aes(x = yi, y = sei), shape = 21, fill = "#2a78d6",
                   color = "#184f95", alpha = 0.75, size = 2.2)
  }
  p + scale_y_reverse(limits = c(se_max, 0)) +
    labs(title = title, subtitle = subtitle, x = "Effect size", y = "Standard error") +
    theme_lsm
}

# ── Univariate coefficient table ─────────────────────────────────────────────
fmt_est_ci <- function(est, lb, ub) sprintf("%.3f [%.3f, %.3f]", est, lb, ub)
fmt_p      <- function(p) ifelse(p < .001, "<.001", sprintf("%.3f", p))

build_univariate_table <- function(uni_fit_list, coefs_df, with_scale) {
  k_tbl <- tibble(moderator = names(uni_fit_list),
                  k = vapply(uni_fit_list, function(f) nrow(f$data), integer(1)))
  df  <- coefs_df %>% filter(!grepl("intrcpt", term))
  out <- df %>% filter(component == "location") %>%
    transmute(moderator, term, Beta_95CI = fmt_est_ci(estimate, ci.lb, ci.ub), p_beta = fmt_p(p))
  if (with_scale)
    out <- full_join(out, df %>% filter(component == "scale") %>%
                       transmute(moderator, term, Alpha_95PLCI = fmt_est_ci(estimate, ci.lb, ci.ub),
                                 p_alpha = fmt_p(p)),
                     by = c("moderator", "term"))
  out %>% left_join(k_tbl, by = "moderator") %>% relocate(k, .after = term) %>%
    rename(Moderator = moderator, Term = term, N = k)
}

# ── Association heatmaps (lower triangle) ────────────────────────────────────
SEQ_BLUE <- c("#f7fbff", "#cde2fb", "#9ec5f4", "#5598e7", "#2a78d6", "#184f95", "#0d366b")
DIV_BR   <- c("#0d366b", "#2a78d6", "#f0efec", "#e34948", "#7a1616")

render_lower_triangle <- function(full, mods, limits, title, legend_title, diverging = FALSE) {
  pal <- if (diverging) DIV_BR else SEQ_BLUE
  full$var1 <- factor(full$var1, levels = mods)
  full$var2 <- factor(full$var2, levels = rev(mods))
  full$is_diag  <- as.character(full$var1) == as.character(full$var2)
  full$fill_val <- ifelse(full$is_diag, NA_real_, full$val)
  # label colour from cell luminance
  nv  <- pmin(pmax((full$fill_val - limits[1]) / diff(limits), 0), 1)
  rgb <- colorRamp(pal)(ifelse(is.na(nv), 0.15, nv))
  lum <- (0.299 * rgb[, 1] + 0.587 * rgb[, 2] + 0.114 * rgb[, 3]) / 255
  full$text_col <- ifelse(full$is_diag, "grey40", ifelse(lum > 0.55, "#0b0b0b", "#ffffff"))

  ggplot(full, aes(x = var1, y = var2)) +
    geom_tile(aes(fill = fill_val), color = "white", linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(is.na(val), "", sprintf("%.2f", val)), color = text_col),
              size = 3.4, fontface = "bold", na.rm = TRUE) +
    scale_color_identity() +
    scale_fill_gradientn(colors = pal, limits = limits, na.value = "grey88", name = legend_title,
                         guide = guide_colorbar(barwidth = 14, barheight = 0.6,
                                                title.position = "top", title.hjust = 0.5)) +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    coord_fixed() +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
          panel.grid = element_blank(), legend.position = "bottom")
}

pairwise_lower <- function(data, mods, fn) {
  vals <- map_dfr(combn(mods, 2, simplify = FALSE), function(p) {
    sub <- data %>% select(all_of(p)) %>% drop_na()
    tibble(var1 = p[2], var2 = p[1],
           val = tryCatch(fn(sub[[p[1]]], sub[[p[2]]]), error = function(e) NA_real_))
  })
  bind_rows(vals, tibble(var1 = mods, var2 = mods, val = 1))
}

plot_assoc_heatmap <- function(data, mods, title) {
  render_lower_triangle(pairwise_lower(data, mods, assoc_strength), mods, c(0, 1), title,
                        "Association\nstrength")
}

plot_corr_heatmap_continuous <- function(data, cont_vars, var_labels, title) {
  full <- pairwise_lower(data, cont_vars, function(x, y) cor(x, y, use = "pairwise.complete.obs"))
  lbl  <- setNames(var_labels, cont_vars)
  full$var1 <- lbl[full$var1]; full$var2 <- lbl[full$var2]
  render_lower_triangle(full, var_labels, c(-1, 1), title, "Pearson r", diverging = TRUE)
}

# ── Univariate plots: bubble (continuous) and density (categorical) ──────────
# Location: observed yi with the model-implied line (RoB held at its mean).
# Scale: fitted tau^2 per comparison with the model-implied line.
# Prediction for both model classes (rma.ls: ideation; rma.uni: attempts).
# Methods are called directly because S3 dispatch can be masked.
pred_fit <- function(fit, ...) {
  if (inherits(fit, "rma.ls")) metafor:::predict.rma.ls(fit, ...) else metafor:::predict.rma(fit, ...)
}
bubble_predict_grid <- function(fo, n = 100) {
  fit <- fo$fit; dat <- fo$data; mod <- fo$moderator; rv <- fo$rob_var
  xseq <- seq(min(dat[[mod]], na.rm = TRUE), max(dat[[mod]], na.rm = TRUE), length.out = n)
  nm <- if (mod == rv) matrix(xseq, ncol = 1, dimnames = list(NULL, mod)) else
    matrix(cbind(xseq, mean(dat[[rv]], na.rm = TRUE)), ncol = 2, dimnames = list(NULL, c(mod, rv)))
  pr  <- pred_fit(fit, newmods = nm)
  out <- tibble(x = xseq, loc_pred = pr$pred, loc_lb = pr$ci.lb, loc_ub = pr$ci.ub)
  if (fo$with_scale) {
    ps <- pred_fit(fit, newscale = nm)   # log(tau^2) scale
    out$sc_pred <- exp(ps$pred); out$sc_lb <- exp(ps$ci.lb); out$sc_ub <- exp(ps$ci.ub)
  }
  out
}

plot_bubble_continuous <- function(fo, mod_label, outcome_label) {
  dat <- fo$data %>% mutate(w = 1 / sei^2, tau2_fit = fo$fit$tau2)
  grid <- bubble_predict_grid(fo)
  base <- function(y, ylab, comp, col, ribbon) {
    ggplot() +
      geom_ribbon(data = grid, aes(x = x, ymin = .data[[paste0(ribbon, "_lb")]],
                                   ymax = .data[[paste0(ribbon, "_ub")]]), fill = col, alpha = 0.2) +
      geom_line(data = grid, aes(x = x, y = .data[[paste0(ribbon, "_pred")]]), color = col, linewidth = 0.9) +
      geom_point(data = dat, aes(x = .data[[fo$moderator]], y = .data[[y]], size = w),
                 shape = 21, fill = "grey60", color = "grey30", alpha = 0.75) +
      scale_size_continuous(name = "Weight\n(1/SE^2)", range = c(1.5, 8)) +
      labs(title = paste0(outcome_label, " - ", mod_label, " (", comp, ")"), x = mod_label, y = ylab) +
      theme_lsm
  }
  list(location = base("yi", "Effect size (yi)", "Location", "steelblue4", "loc"),
       scale    = if (fo$with_scale) base("tau2_fit", expression("Estimate of " * tau^2),
                                          "Scale", "firebrick4", "sc"))
}

plot_density_categorical <- function(fo, mod_label, outcome_label) {
  dat <- fo$data %>% mutate(tau2_fit = fo$fit$tau2)
  grp <- fo$moderator
  n_lev <- nlevels(droplevels(factor(dat[[grp]])))
  pal <- if (n_lev <= 8) brewer.pal(max(3, n_lev), "Set2")[seq_len(n_lev)] else viridis(n_lev)
  base <- function(x, xlab, comp) {
    ggplot(dat, aes(x = .data[[x]], fill = .data[[grp]], color = .data[[grp]])) +
      geom_density(alpha = 0.35, linewidth = 0.8) +
      geom_rug(alpha = 0.6) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = pal, name = mod_label) +
      scale_color_manual(values = pal, name = mod_label) +
      labs(title = paste0(outcome_label, " - ", mod_label, " (", comp, ")"), x = xlab, y = "Density") +
      theme_lsm
  }
  list(location = base("yi", "Effect size (yi)", "Location"),
       scale    = if (fo$with_scale) base("tau2_fit", expression("Fitted " * tau^2), "Scale"))
}

# ── Profile likelihood (scale coefficients only; metafor profiles alpha only) ─
plot_profile_grid <- function(uni_fit_list, outcome_label, steps = 20) {
  panels <- list()
  for (mod in names(uni_fit_list)) {
    fo <- uni_fit_list[[mod]]
    if (!isTRUE(fo$with_scale) || is.null(fo$fit$alpha)) next
    an <- rownames(fo$fit$alpha)
    keep <- if (mod == fo$rob_var) which(an != "intrcpt") else which(!an %in% c("intrcpt", fo$rob_var))
    for (idx in keep) {
      lbl <- if (length(keep) > 1) paste0(mod, ": ", an[idx]) else mod
      pr <- tryCatch(suppressWarnings(metafor:::profile.rma.ls(
              fo$fit, alpha = idx, plot = FALSE, progbar = FALSE, steps = steps)),
            error = function(e) NULL)
      if (!is.null(pr))
        panels[[lbl]] <- tibble(x = pr$alpha, ll = pr$ll, mle = fo$fit$alpha[idx],
                                maxll = max(pr$ll, na.rm = TRUE))
    }
  }
  if (!length(panels)) return(NULL)
  ggplot(bind_rows(panels, .id = "panel"), aes(x = x, y = ll)) +
    geom_line(color = "steelblue4", linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_point(size = 0.8, color = "steelblue4") +
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept = mle), linetype = "dotted", color = "grey30") +
    geom_hline(aes(yintercept = maxll), linetype = "dotted", color = "grey30") +
    facet_wrap(~ panel, scales = "free", ncol = 3) +
    labs(title = paste0(outcome_label, " - Profile likelihood (scale coefficients)"),
         x = expression(alpha), y = "Log-likelihood") +
    theme_lsm
}

# ── Multi-model plots ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
plot_aicc_profile <- function(mm, title) {
  df <- tibble(aicc = sort(mm$aicc)) %>% mutate(rank = row_number())
  ggplot(df, aes(x = rank, y = aicc)) +
    geom_point(size = 1.3, color = "grey30", alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = min(df$aicc), color = "firebrick", linetype = "dashed") +
    labs(title = title, subtitle = paste(nrow(df), "converged candidate models"),
         x = "Model rank (best to worst)", y = "AICc") +
    theme_lsm
}

# Importance is identical for loc_X and scale_X (same moderators in both
# components), so one bar per moderator.
plot_importance <- function(mm_avg, title) {
  df <- mm_avg %>% filter(!parameter %in% c("loc_intrcpt", "scale_intrcpt")) %>%
    mutate(param_short = sub("^(loc_|scale_)", "", parameter)) %>%
    distinct(param_short, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    arrange(importance) %>%
    mutate(param_short = factor(param_short, levels = param_short))
  ggplot(df, aes(x = param_short, y = importance)) +
    geom_col(fill = "steelblue", width = 0.65) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0.8, color = "firebrick", linetype = "dashed") +
    coord_flip() + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = "Importance (sum of Akaike weights)") +
    theme_lsm
}

plot_coef_forest <- function(mm_avg, title, component = c("all", "loc", "scale")) {
  component <- match.arg(component)
  df <- mm_avg %>% filter(!parameter %in% c("loc_intrcpt", "scale_intrcpt"))
  if (component != "all") df <- df %>% filter(startsWith(parameter, paste0(component, "_")))
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(comp = ifelse(startsWith(parameter, "scale_"), "Scale", "Location"),
           param_short = sub("^(loc_|scale_)", "", parameter),
           sig = ifelse(p < 0.05, "p < .05", "n.s.")) %>%
    arrange(comp, estimate) %>%
    mutate(row_id = factor(row_number(), labels = param_short))
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = estimate, y = row_id, color = sig)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
    geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = ci.lb, xmax = ci.ub), height = 0.2) +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("p < .05" = "firebrick", "n.s." = "grey40"), name = NULL) +
    labs(title = title, x = "Model-averaged estimate (95% CI)", y = NULL) +
    theme_lsm
  if (component == "all") p <- p + facet_wrap(~ comp, scales = "free", ncol = 1)
  p
}
```

```{r main-figures, fig.width = 7.5, fig.height = 6}
# ── Theme ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
pick_font <- function() {
  if (requireNamespace("systemfonts", quietly = TRUE)) {
    fams <- unique(systemfonts::system_fonts()$family)
    for (f in c("Arial", "Helvetica", "Liberation Sans", "Arimo")) if (f %in% fams) return(f)
  }
  "sans"
}
FONT <- pick_font()
pt   <- 1 / .pt   # pt -> ggplot linewidth units

theme_jad <- function(base = 7) {
  theme_classic(base_size = base, base_family = FONT) %+replace%
    theme(
      axis.line          = element_line(linewidth = 0.5 * pt, colour = "black"),
      axis.ticks         = element_line(linewidth = 0.5 * pt, colour = "black"),
      axis.ticks.length  = unit(1.2, "pt"),
      axis.text          = element_text(size = base - 0.5, colour = "black"),
      axis.title         = element_text(size = base),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_line(linewidth = 0.25 * pt, colour = "grey88"),
      plot.title         = element_text(size = base, face = "bold", hjust = 0, margin = margin(b = 3)),
      plot.tag           = element_text(size = base + 1, face = "bold"),
      legend.text        = element_text(size = base - 0.5),
      legend.title       = element_text(size = base - 0.5),
      legend.key.size    = unit(8, "pt"),
      strip.background   = element_blank(),
      strip.text         = element_text(size = base, face = "bold", hjust = 0, margin = margin(b = 3)),
      plot.margin        = margin(4, 6, 4, 4)
    )
}
theme_jad_y <- theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
                     panel.grid.major.y = element_line(linewidth = 0.25 * pt, colour = "grey88"))

OI <- c(blue = "#0072B2", vermillion = "#D55E00", green = "#009E73",
        orange = "#E69F00", sky = "#56B4E9", grey = "#999999")
SIZE_RANGE <- c(0.7, 3.2)
rr_breaks  <- c(0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2, 4)
rr_axis    <- sec_axis(~ exp(.), name = "Risk ratio", breaks = rr_breaks,
                       labels = format(rr_breaks, drop0trailing = TRUE))

# ── Model-implied estimates per factor level (RoB score at its mean) ─────────
new_row <- function(level, cols, mod, rob_var, rob_mean) {
  cols <- setdiff(cols, "intrcpt")
  v <- setNames(numeric(length(cols)), cols)
  if (paste0(mod, level) %in% cols) v[paste0(mod, level)] <- 1
  if (rob_var %in% cols) v[rob_var] <- rob_mean
  v
}

group_estimates <- function(res) {
  fit <- res$fit; dat <- res$data; mod <- res$moderator; rv <- res$rob_var
  lev  <- levels(droplevels(factor(dat[[mod]])))
  rbar <- mean(dat[[rv]], na.rm = TRUE)
  Xn  <- do.call(rbind, lapply(lev, new_row, colnames(fit$X), mod, rv, rbar))
  loc <- pred_fit(fit, newmods = Xn)
  out <- tibble(level = lev, k = as.integer(table(factor(dat[[mod]], levels = lev))),
                est = as.numeric(loc$pred), lb = as.numeric(loc$ci.lb), ub = as.numeric(loc$ci.ub))
  if (!is.null(fit$alpha) && ncol(fit$Z) > 1) {
    Zn <- do.call(rbind, lapply(lev, new_row, colnames(fit$Z), mod, rv, rbar))
    sc <- pred_fit(fit, newscale = Zn)
    out <- out %>% mutate(tau2 = exp(as.numeric(sc$pred)),
                          tau2_lb = exp(as.numeric(sc$ci.lb)),
                          tau2_ub = exp(as.numeric(sc$ci.ub)))
  }
  out
}

# Strip plot: observed effects (size = inverse-variance weight, fixed-seed
# jitter) and model estimate with 95% CI to the right of each group
plot_group_effects <- function(res, level_labels, fill_cols, y_lab, title) {
  mod <- res$moderator
  ge  <- group_estimates(res) %>%
    mutate(x = row_number(), axis = sprintf("%s\n(k = %d)", level_labels[level], k))
  set.seed(2026)
  dat <- res$data %>%
    mutate(level = as.character(.data[[mod]]),
           x = match(level, ge$level) - 0.12 + runif(n(), -0.13, 0.13),
           w = 1 / sei^2) %>%
    arrange(desc(w))
  ggplot() +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.4 * pt, linetype = "22", colour = "grey40") +
    geom_point(data = dat, aes(x = x, y = yi, size = w, fill = level),
               shape = 21, colour = "white", stroke = 0.25) +
    geom_errorbar(data = ge, aes(x = x + 0.24, ymin = lb, ymax = ub), width = 0, linewidth = 0.75 * pt) +
    geom_point(data = ge, aes(x = x + 0.24, y = est), shape = 23, size = 2, fill = "black") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = setNames(fill_cols, ge$level), guide = "none") +
    scale_size(range = SIZE_RANGE, guide = "none") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = ge$x, labels = ge$axis, expand = expansion(add = 0.45)) +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = y_lab) +
    theme_jad() + theme_jad_y + theme(axis.ticks.x = element_blank())
}

# ── Figure 3: importance across specifications ───────────────────────────────
# One importance value per moderator (all dummy columns of a factor share it)
param_to_var <- function(param, vars) {
  vapply(sub("^(loc_|scale_)", "", param), function(t) {
    hit <- vars[startsWith(t, vars)]
    if (length(hit)) hit[which.max(nchar(hit))] else NA_character_
  }, character(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}

importance_tbl <- function(mm, spec, outcome) {
  if (is.null(mm)) return(NULL)
  mm$avg %>%
    filter(startsWith(parameter, "loc_"), parameter != "loc_intrcpt") %>%
    mutate(var = param_to_var(parameter, var_labels$var)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(var)) %>%
    group_by(var) %>% summarise(importance = max(importance), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(spec = spec, outcome = outcome)
}

specs    <- c("Primary analysis", "RoB score forced", "Excl. influential studies", "Excl. outliers")
outcomes <- c("Suicidal ideation", "Suicide attempts")

imp <- bind_rows(
  importance_tbl(mm_si,           specs[1], outcomes[1]),
  importance_tbl(mm_si_forced,    specs[2], outcomes[1]),
  importance_tbl(mm_si_excl_infl, specs[3], outcomes[1]),
  importance_tbl(sens_out_si$mm,  specs[4], outcomes[1]),
  importance_tbl(mm_at,           specs[1], outcomes[2]),
  importance_tbl(mm_at_forced,    specs[2], outcomes[2]),
  importance_tbl(mm_at_excl_infl, specs[3], outcomes[2]),
  importance_tbl(sens_out_at$mm,  specs[4], outcomes[2])
) %>%
  filter(!(var == ROB_VAR & spec == specs[2]))   # importance = 1 by construction

  mutate(domain = factor(domain, levels = c("Study", "Intervention", "Sample")),
         label  = factor(label, levels = rev(label)))

  mutate(spec = factor(spec, levels = specs), outcome = factor(outcome, levels = outcomes))

# Candidates with no converged model in the primary analysis

  anti_join(imp %>% filter(spec == specs[1]) %>% mutate(outcome = as.character(outcome)),
            by = c("var", "outcome")) %>%
  inner_join(shown, by = "var") %>%
  mutate(outcome = factor(outcome, levels = outcomes))

rng <- imp %>% group_by(outcome, domain, label) %>%
  summarise(lo = min(importance), hi = max(importance), .groups = "drop")

spec_shape <- setNames(c(21, 24, 22, 23), specs)
spec_fill  <- setNames(c("black", OI[["sky"]], OI[["orange"]], "white"), specs)

rng     <- rng     %>% mutate(y = as.numeric(label))

lab_lookup <- setNames(levels(shown$label), seq_along(levels(shown$label)))

  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.8, linewidth = 0.4 * pt, linetype = "22", colour = "grey40") +

# ── Export ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
save_jad <- function(plot, name, width_mm = 190, height_mm, dpi = 1000) {
  w <- width_mm / 25.4; h <- height_mm / 25.4
  f <- function(ext) file.path(out_dir, paste0(name, ext))
  ggsave(f(".pdf"), plot, width = w, height = h, device = cairo_pdf)
  ggsave(f(".eps"), plot, width = w, height = h, device = cairo_ps, fallback_resolution = dpi)
  tiff_dev <- if (requireNamespace("ragg", quietly = TRUE)) ragg::agg_tiff else "tiff"
  ggsave(f(".tiff"), plot, width = w, height = h, dpi = dpi, device = tiff_dev, compression = "lzw")
}
```
